_note: WhatsApp Web. Message rows carry data-id = "<true|false>_<chat jid>_<message id>". Copy this file to services\whatsapp.json in Mnemo's config folder to override any field.

recalled: Tin nhắn này đã bị xóa
Bạn đã xóa tin nhắn này

selfAvatar.sel: [aria-label='Profile' i] img[src], [aria-label='Hồ sơ' i] img[src], [aria-label='Profile photo' i] img[src], [aria-label='Ảnh hồ sơ' i] img[src], [title='Profile' i] img[src], [title='Hồ sơ' i] img[src]

selfAvatar.not: #main, #pane-side, [aria-label*='Meta AI' i], [title*='Meta AI' i], [aria-label*='Status' i], [aria-label*='Trạng thái' i]

_noteAvatar: Your own photo is the Profile button at the bottom of the left rail (2025+ layout). Only profile photos (pps.whatsapp.net) count, so the Meta AI icon in the same rail is never taken as your avatar.
_avatarNote: Your photo is the bottom item of WhatsApp's left rail; the Meta AI button above it also shows a pps.whatsapp.net picture, so it is excluded.

unreadCount.sel: #pane-side span[aria-label*='unread message' i], #pane-side span[aria-label*='tin nhắn chưa đọc' i]

_unreadNote: unreadCount: the unread-message total is the sum of the chat list's badges (muted chats left out), not the page title. Only conversations the list has drawn are counted; scrolled-away ones aren't.
